notes: Official code loads images/ at 3DGS -r -1 => width 1600 (mipnerf360-1600). One 30k run = 3DGS 7k + coarse sdf to 15k + mesh extraction (CPU Open3D from ~/models/sugar-pylib, appended to sys.path automatically; ~5-10 min) + 15k refinement with ~2M mesh-bound Gaussians. Smoke: 4000 steps in 19 min on a busy A6000, peak 3 GB at images_4. Compare delta vs 1600 baseline with paper delta vs its 3DGS row (-2.05/-2.11/-1.08 dB).
protocol_note: Review-1 major: paper metrics are at max side 1920 (SuGaR load_gs_cameras, cameras.py:16/113-117), not 1600. Only the official vanilla 3DGS 7k stage (-r -1 = 1600) and mesh extraction use 1600; our single run uses 1920 throughout (gap).
